clusterMetrics.clusterText: Interactive evidence viewThe result changes when the denominator changes.The rank-flip view compares OSM people-per-facility with registry people-per-facility for all Philippine regions. The scatter asks whether the OSM access score is mostly a mapping completeness signal.
